title: 국립중앙도서관과 그 소속 도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (User Registration, etc.)
(1) A person who intends to use the materials or facilities of a library (excluding the National Library of Korea, Sejong) shall register as a user on the library's website and obtain a library user card. <Amended on February 28, 2014>
(2) A person who intends to borrow materials from the National Library of Korea, Sejong for use outside the library shall register as a user on its website and obtain a borrowing card. <Newly inserted on February 28, 2014>
(3) Detailed matters concerning user registration and issuance of user and borrowing cards shall be determined by the library director. <Amended on February 28, 2014>
